intra-muscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle
Firm swelling in the posterior triangle of her left neck
intra-muscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle

concepts.why: The patient's presentation of left-sided neck pain, neck stiffness, and torticollis, combined with imaging studies showing an intramuscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle, supports this diagnosis.

The patient's laboratory tests, including a high white blood cell count and C-reactive protein level, along with the microbiological culture result showing F. necrophorum infection, support this diagnosis.
The patient's presentation of neck pain, stiffness, and torticollis, combined with imaging studies showing an intramuscular abscess, is consistent with pyomyositis.
The patient's imaging studies, including CT and MRI, show a poorly defined collection in the left paraspinal musculature, supporting this diagnosis.
